P0.title: Fault-cycle output acceptance violates fail-closed atomicity
P0.detail: protocol_error includes combinational illegal_event, but header_valid and raw_valid are gated only by registered fault_q. A wrong-tag event concurrent with a legal raw output gives protocol_error=1 and raw_accept=1. The sequential block refuses to advance because protocol_error is high, while the downstream consumer observes a transfer. The production idle-only attack does not cover this case; independent fresh VCS reproduces it.

P0.title: No admitted executable H67 producer-to-FC2 path
P0.detail: The original checkpoint unit threshold proves binary amplitude identity but does not admit the approximate M167 dynamic-BN/rank3 producer. M167 rank3 accuracy is false, PAFT hardware accuracy is false, the dynamic-BN barrier remains, and no M167-to-M231-to-M216/M218 cross-module VCS or trace schedule exists. Therefore the generic bridge is useful, but 875.52 MB cannot yet be promoted as an achieved H67 hardware benefit.

P1.title: Two-slot finite-buffer performance is not executed
P1.detail: The mean M218 service-over-producer ratios show the consumer is slower and therefore predict backpressure; they do not prove recurrence, overlap, stall distribution, deadlock freedom, or cycle gain on the ordered 120-record payload.

P1.title: PAFT threshold evidence is receipt-only
P1.detail: The local audit can verify the M162 summary SHA and its 12/12 statement, but the PAFT checkpoint is not local. PAFT is also explicitly not selected after no-running versus running BN and M193 recalibration evaluation.

P1.title: Traffic baseline is counterfactual and memory-level unspecified
P1.detail: 875,520,000 bytes assumes one packed write and one packed read for every FC2 input bit. No matched materializing RTL, SRAM banking/ports, address trace, or measured transaction count exists. It is not DRAM traffic and has no energy conversion.

P1.title: DC state is implemented entirely as flops
P1.detail: The sequential-cell counts track the 4*INPUT_WIDTH storage closely. All four runs have zero macros and ZeroWireload; the 40,849 um2 W3072 point is a full-flop diagnostic, not an SRAM-buffer PPA point. Hold was repaired with set_fix_hold and the reported minimum slack is only 0.2 to 0.8 ps in this idealized model.

P1.title: Directed verification is shallow
P1.detail: Each width runs only three deterministic pairs. Random seeds do not alter data or stall patterns. The only production attack is an orphan event while idle; wrong tag/group/last during fill, attack during header/raw drain, reset during fill/drain, counter rollover, and simultaneous slot turnover are not systematically covered.

P1.title: Contract and screen do not carry post-VCS/DC admission
P1.detail: The frozen contract and screen retain vcs=false even though later receipts exist. A superseding exact-SHA admission overlay should bind the repaired RTL, fresh VCS, DC, and independent review without rewriting old evidence.

P1.title: No post-synthesis functional or power closure
P1.detail: There is no Formality, mapped-netlist VCS, PT STA, SAIF or PTPX for M231. Current positive slack is a DC pre-layout diagnostic and cannot support paper PPA or energy.

P2.title: Producer ordering is implicit
P2.detail: M231 requires one pair header followed by contiguous group indices 0..GROUPS-1. M167 exposes only a result tag and event word; the adapter that derives pair tag, group index and last-group is not specified.

P2.title: Row-bit tag transformation needs an integration contract
P2.detail: M231 consumes a TAG_BITS-1 pair tag and appends the row bit to form the M216 token tag. The available tag-width reduction, uniqueness lifetime and M218 downstream interpretation should be frozen in the cross-module wrapper.

P2.title: Population remains ten samples
P2.detail: The arithmetic is exact for the frozen ten-sample, 120-record payload only. It gives no cross-sequence or event-density distribution for traffic or stalls.

P2.title: Runner hygiene still names the reused M216 flow
P2.detail: The DC Tcl emits M216-specific elaboration wording and uses a reused constraint/Tcl identity. Functionally benign, but a dedicated M231 wrapper would reduce evidence ambiguity.

minimum_next_milestone.name: M231r2 atomic quarantine and executable M167/M216 trace bridge
requirements: Gate header_valid, raw_valid and every accept with the current-cycle fault term, not only fault_q; add assertions that protocol_error implies no external or internal acceptance in the attack cycle.
Add wrong-tag, wrong-group, wrong-last and orphan-event attacks during fill, header drain and raw drain, plus reset and simultaneous two-slot turnover tests at all four widths.
Build a typed adapter from M167 BACK result tag/event bits to M231 pair/group metadata and instantiate M216 on the output; extend through M218 group service or provide an exact interface miter.

Execute the ordered 120-record payload with the two-slot buffer, dynamic-BN barrier, real ready/valid stalls and a matched packed-SRAM materialization baseline; report cycles, stall causes and achieved on-chip transactions separately.
Keep H67 accuracy conditional until an exact producer is used or M167 rank3/PAFT dynamic-BN accuracy is admitted; keep SRAM, DRAM, energy, complete FFN and system claims false meanwhile.
Rerun exact-SHA VCS and matched DC after the RTL fix, then add Formality or mapped-netlist equivalence before promotion.
